label: First Wait — inaction is an action
candidates: You wait. Those who watch learn you do not matter.
When you withhold, the watchers drift toward apathy.
You do nothing. Nearby, indifference takes root.
Wait, and you teach the people watching that you are not worth their feeling.
Inaction is witnessed. It pushes them toward grey.
To wait is to be forgotten. The nearby lose their color.
You hold back. Those who see it move toward apathy.
Waiting is a choice. It makes you matter less to those who witness it.
